balls.text: lands the yorker on off stump, but yet it goes for a couple to deep midwicket
it's the short ball, and it's slower as well. Can't bowl that with fine leg up
slapped away! it's a length ball and yusuf laps it up. He had made room outside leg and Bhuvi sought to beat him outside off. Couldn't do it
premeditates the yorker as he runs away outside off to scoop it over his right shoulder. But Bhuvi follows Chawla outside off and forces him to mistime it
goes short and it's a bolt out of the blue for Yusuf! Goes for an awkward pull, gets a top edge and is nearly caught at short fine leg. Doesn't reach him
hits the yorker on middle, Chawla gets an inside edge onto pad and a single as the ricochet goes away into the off side
manages to find the blockhole outside leg, Chawla squeezes it out into the covers after making room for himself
low full toss outside off, slapped away to deep point
follows him as he makes room, but Chawla is still able to dab the slower ball to third man
full and wide, Yusuf creams it through the covers. But there is protection in the deep
slower ball a shade outside off, Chawla tries to push it into the covers but the offcutter sticks in the wicket and takes a thick inside edge
flicked away to the long leg boundary! Steyn's bowling at full tilt and that's helping the batsman. Then again, this was a poor ball down the leg side. Deserved the treatment
the reverse sweep consumes another man. Slower, length ball on off stump, scooped up only as far as point. Henriques calls for it and takes it diving forward

slower ball outside off, but he's moved across to bring his wrists into play. And they're powerful, indeed. Whipped away, and it's too square for Bipul from long leg to catch up. Where're the yorkers, Bhuvi?
fuller and outside off, flicked to deep square leg
does him in on the second try! Goes for the reverse swat again, but this time Bhuvi's pulled his length back and slanted it outside leg stump. The edge goes against the batsman, for once

how bout that? He didn't middle it, I doubt he wanted any more than a couple, but the ball leaps off his bat and over the bounder behind him! That's a proper top edge as he went for a reverse scoop! Good option though, as he realised Bhuvi will go for the yorker. Came out as a low full toss and it just pinged away
back of a length on off stump, Yusuf gets across and whips to square leg

short fine leg nearly pushed it away to the boundary, but Praveen's little gaffe has been saved by Bipul. Shortish delivery, came onto him a little quicker as he went for a pull. Inside edge skews away behind him
back of a length and outside off, Botha goes deep in his crease and flicks to deep midwicket
good length ball on off stump, punched to long-off
shortish and outside off, Botha goes for a cut and gets a bottom edge towards point
can only sneak a single after he misses the slower ball with his flick. Slipped off his pads towards the leg side
he hammered them last season, and he's in that room again. It's a fuller delivery, but Yusuf has pulled out those powerful wrists and nails it over mdiwicket
shortish and outside off, Botha is about two years late on the pull and gets an inside edge to the long leg boundary. Good note for KKR to get to the time out
149kph, fuller and wide outside off, Botha the new bat, slashes and misses
goes short and outside off, Pathan pulls but mistimes it towards midwicket. They go for a run, it's a tight one. And Vihari could have had him if the throw had hit
back of a length and outside off, Yusuf slides it to point
goes short and it slips a bit too far outside off. Yusuf is lead-footed and slashes, misses
slammed down the ground! Pace on the ball doesn't seem like the way to go on this pitch. Steyn bowls full on of stump, but the ball is sent back even quicker
great work from Henriques at point. Flings himself to his left and contains a rasping cut short from Yusuf. Could have easily been a four. Steyn owes him a drink for that

gets his man this time! Back of a length on middle, not quite short enough for the pull. Tendo disagrees. Unfortunately for him, it stays low too. Misses the ball and is struck quite low in front of all three stumps.
gets across on off stump and whips a fuller ball to wide long-on. Another off-pace delivery
slower ball on off stump, Pathan defends
back of a length and outside off, punched into the covers
low full toss on middle, Tendo taps it to long-on
Cuts back in and Henriques is excited. I think the impact was outside off. Good length ball brings Tendo forward to block. Skids on at him too quickly and his bat is hidden behind the pad

good length ball on leg stump, tucked away into the leg side for a single. Bipul races after this one as well, and then flings an overthrow. Loopy throw wide of the man backing up at the bowler's end. Henriques it was, who uses only one hand for the job. Sloppy

he's gone! It certainly appears so. Bipul has beaten the batsman in flight - Pandey was rushing down the track, but he realises the ball has been held back. All he can do is bunt it into the off side and then he gets greedy. Wants a single, but Tendo says no. Amid the indecision, Bipul has rushed across and slung a throw to the keeper. Ojha does the rest
saw the batsman hurrying down the pitch and pushed it well wide of off stump, Pandey has to stretch a long way to reach it and slogs it to long-on
short, with enough room for Tendo to jump back and cut to deep point
looped up outside off, almost a wide even, but Pandey has been able to slash it to deep cover
tossed up on middle and leg, clipped with soft hands through the midwicket region. This time the two is well on. KKR bring up their 100
good length ball, pushed through on middle, turned away to deep midwicket where Dhawan rushes in to keep it to a single
reasonably straighter delivery outside off, slid behind point
whipped away to deep square leg
too short from Karn and Pandey has camped back and sliced it through point. Brilliant strike
skips down the track again to a good length ball on off stump and hammers it down the ground. Soars over long-off

Morgan's taken it this time! Nothing more than a slog from Russel, on one knee, and the slowness of the pitch, not to mention Bipul's decision not to afford the batsman any pace, means he has miscued it. Easy take for the long-on fielder
gets down the track and directs the good length ball into the covers

Morgan and Vihari almost pull off the hokey pokey! Pandey had jumped forward, to the pitch of the slow, loopy delivery and thumped it over long-on. It seemed headed for a six, until Morgan positioned himself on the edge of the boundary, leapt up, thrust his hands behind him, took the catch and then parried it to the fielder who was backing up. But the push back into the field didn't have enough power behind it
a bit of spin again, Russell stays back and drills it to long-off
flighted a shade outside off, punched into the covers
flighted on middle and leg, Pandey is down the pitch with a nudge to long-on

captain's come up with another stunner! It was drummed into the covers after Uthappa had made room to free his arms. It was a flatter delivery as well. The problem though was he didn't place it far enough from  Warner, who dives low to his right and assures himself of a spot in the highlights of the match later
firesd in quicker, and it's shorter as well, he stays back and pulls to long-on
slower through the air, not giving the batsman anything to work with, defended down the pitch
flighted outside off, Uthappa moves beside it and slices it to point
flighted outside off, driven into the covers

down the track to a flatter ball on off stump, drilled back at the bowler who was looking to parry it onto the stumps as well. Gets some contact too, but it isn't enough. Karn flings his hands in disappointment. Knew Pandey was well outside his crease backing up
plants that front foot outside off and sweeps the flighted delivery to deep square leg

leeeeading edge! But it falls safely! Pandey is looking to charge to bowler too often and Bipul's got his number. Slows it all the way down, gets it to grip and turn right across his flick. That shot would have been a good option had he been able to smother the spin, but he isn't.
gets back outside leg and cuts the ball from the stumps to the man in the deep
leans forward and drives into the covers. Can't find the gap
that's the change-up, but he keeps it full as well. Skids through and beats Uthappa's cut handsomely
rushes at the bowler, but Bipul's slow pace is working here. He doesn't let the batsman get under him, inside edge skews away through midwicket
waits on it a touch more to try and beat short fine leg. Manages to do so
reaches forward and works it into the vacant real estate at midwicket again
goes back and tickles it to midwicket. Big gap there
a slap from Steyn keeps the ball inside the field! Good work on the long-on boundary after Pandey cleared his front leg and thumped a flighted delivery wide of the man.
flighted on off stump, Pandey drives to the left of the bowler, who rushes after it and parries it to short cover
fired in on off stump, Pandey stays back and slaps it to point

waits on a slightly shortish delivery, looks for the old scoop-pull to long leg. But the ball takes ages to come to him and his timing goes for a toss. Can't even get the leg bye because the ball didn't go far enough into the square
stays beside the tossed up delivery on off stump and scythes it to the left of long-off
ah, no dart then. Keeps it flighted on off stump and Pandey defends
down the track, to the pitch, and mauled over long-on! He loved the ball looping above his eyeline, lunged at it straight away and muscles it
slower through the air and tossed up outside off, Pandey runs it to point
good length, outside off, punched away to deep point
holds his length back and has Pandey uncertain. Manages to hug bat and pad together and keep the skidder out
brings Pandey forward as he drives to short cover
stays back this time to a fuller, flatter delivery. Rather unlike his usual game. Manages to slice it behind point and sneak a quick single
flighted outside off, turned away through midwicket

he's miscued that! Lovely, loopy delivery outside off stump enticed the batsman into a slog sweep. But unlike the last ball, he wasn't able to get to the pitch. The ball bounces a bit more than he thought and that's enough to snare the top edge. It still carries to Morgan at deep midwicket though
down the track first ball and hammers the flighted delivery to deep midwicket
back of a lenght and outside off, Uthappa reaches outside his off stump to punch into the covers. Also, a time out
another slower ball, a shade shortish, pulled to deep square leg
strays a little too leg-sidish again and this time it kisses the thigh pad and scurries away to the long leg boundary
belted down the ground! With Dibbly-dobbly pace, he can't afford to bowl half-volleys. Gambhir drills that lesson into him as he swings freely
another off cutter, Gambhir goes for a slice behind third man but he is beaten by the lack of pace
slower ball on middle and leg, Uthappa shows off his leg stump as he moves across. Turned to long leg
good length ball on off stump, Gambhir is behind it well enough

he's threaded the gap through the covers this time. Punishes Steyn for overpitching! Had enough width too for Gambhir to unleash a cover drive that would leave any fast bowler fuming. That was dominant
flays it to cover point. inched forward to this good length ball and gave it his all. But it just seemed like he was beaten by pace
squares him up with a back of a length delivery that cuts away off middle stump. Gambhir's clip becomes a leading edge to point
shortish on middle and leg, Gambhir is happy to keep to his crease and roll his wrists on top of the ball. Steyn's pace, and fine leg being inside the circle, does the rest
good length ball outside off, the ever eager Uthappa drills it into the covers off the front foot
more inswing for Praveen, but its not threatening enough. Indeed, with Uthappa targeting him in the midwicket to fine leg arc, it helps the batsman. Single off the flick
goes around the wicket for a shortish delivery that's picked off his hips to long leg

lbw shout, but Uthappa had his front foot outside the line of off stump. Looks like that's the plan, drag the medium pacers from wherever they bowl into the leg side. It was a pretty decent ball outside off, Uthappa closes the face too early and is struck too high as well
good length ball, pushed a little wider outside off, turned into the leg side again. But only as far as midwicket
taken it off middle, the result's the same! Praveen instantly calls third man up and fine leg back. A little too straight, and with his lack of pace, Uthappa just picks his spot
fullish on off stump, but Uthappa has got across and used the hints of inswing it had to help it to the fine leg boundary. Brilliant wristwork
stunning sound off the bat as he wades forward again to another back of a length delivery and punches it to cover
shortish and a shade outside off, Uthappa lunges forward though and taps it back at the bowler
good length ball on middle, turned wide of mid-on for a single

he's forgetting his strengths here. Or is he looking to do too much? Starts on a leg stump line seeking the away swinger, but it's back of a length so the ball doesn't move at all. Clipped to the square leg fence again
jumps down the track, Bhuvi pulls his length back, Gambhir slices it to point. One-up's been one-upped
whipped away off middle stump and he's got enough to hit the square leg ropes. Fast outfield, new ball, field up

serenely driven through the covers. That's a top shot from Uthappa, and he would have expected that with Steyn looking for swing. The ball was full and outside off, and he leaned into it. Lovely straight bat bolstered his case
back of a length on leg stump, tucked to square leg
fullish on leg stump, Gambhir flicks it away wide of mid-on

huge appeal from the keeper, Steyn joins in, Kolkata roars as well, But Marais Erasmus shakes his head. Ripper of a delivery as he pitches it up and gets it to cut across Gauti's intended flick. There was a noise, but it was heard after the ball passed bat.
tempts Gauti to come forward, but that's extra pace is making the batsman nervous. No foot movement as he pushes towards the off side
146ph, good length ball on of stump, steered towards point. The fielder dives to his right but can't reach it. Morgan it was, and by the time third man can mop it up, the batsmen have stolen a couple
strays a bit too straight and Gambhir is relieved to pick it away to long leg.
loads of swing away from the left-hander and Gambhir is beaten. Feeble push outside off no match for Bhuvi's movement
overthrows! Pushes to mid-off and this time Uthappa sets off right away. Warner is the man who spears in a throw at the bowler's end. Beats short midiwcket, and fine leg is too square

cuts this one back in and there was a run out opportunity at Gambhir's end! Uthappa has managed to bring his bat around his huge front foot stride across on off stump to ping short midwicket. Steyn is lurking there, sneaks an underarm throw and could have had the KKR captain for a duck
not quite so solid this time as he is lured into poking at a wider one. Curl away beats him again
upright seam invites a little bit of away swing. Uthappa is watchful as he presses forward and leaves outside off
full and outside off, huge golf swing from Bhuvi. No dice
full on leg stump, whipped to long-on
glum faces at the Sunrisers dig out as Praveen falls as well. It's the slower short ball outside off, gets the ramp in reply and it lobs gently to short third man
runs away from the ball to free those arms, but Russell slants it wide and beats him. Russell didn't use the front arm that time
short ball, again not too much pace behind it, Praveen goes for a pull way too early and misses again
starts with a slower ball outside off, Praveen swings and misses
another slower ball on off stump, Praveen goes deep in his crease to lift it down to long-on
backs away and slaps it through the covers
looks for a hoick over the leg side, but the slower, back of a length ball keeps quite low. Beats him comfortably
back of a length on middle, tries to ride it to third man. Doesn't quite connect well
back of a length on off stump, he makes room for it and thumps the ball straight down the ground. The tail having some fun, like only they can
fuller delivery outside off, he likes the width and smokes it over the covers. Picks up the offcutter and pounces all over it
there's the slog, despite the ball so full and so wide of off stump. Should have looked move over cover instead of long-on. Holes out
that time he's strayed a little too far outside off. Karn can't reach it
a little too much width, although that's a good ploy against a batsman looking leg side. Karn drags it away to long-on on the bounce

there's the hat-trick. Tosses it up in the slot and the slog sweep answers. Right off the middle this time. Sails over midwicket again. And it seems the crowd doesn't want to part with the ball. Until they do, in the end
long hop sent into orbit over midwicket. Kind of the ball that got Dhawan, only Karn had leapt back and unleashed all he had
flighted on off stump, and Karn goes for a heave down the ground. I didn't think he got much bat on that, but there's enough to burst through Pandey's outstretched hands at long-off
signs off with the googly that beats the tailender all ends up. Applause from the dugout. 4-0-17-2
that time he sneaks in the googly and Karn can't read it. Gets an inside edge off the cut for a single to square leg
gorgeous flight. Slows it up nicely, gets it above the batsman's eyeline, then the ball dips. Karn's sweep had no chance
tossed up outside off, pummeled to long-off
stays back and dabs a good length ball to short third man
Lots of turn back in at the batsman shaping to cut, manages to do so despite the ball being on middle
nearly a yorker on off stump, Praveen jams his bat down and gets it to long-on
goes back and nudges it to deep square leg
bit of turn, even off his quicker delivery. Uthappa huts his hand while collecting. Karn is the lucky one, swinging and missing
flighted outside off, pushed into the covers
fired in quick on off stump again but this time Karn is able to run it fine. But short third man is right there waiting
pushed through outside off, Karn is beaten for pace as he looks to slice it to third man
barely reads the googly and at the most final of final moments, plants an open face down and gets a thick edge that beats short third man
shortish and turning away - it's a flipper - Karn pulls it down to long-on
flighted on middle, turned through square leg
loads of turn and Praveen wears one on the pads while trying to flick
another googly, but Karn picks it and clips it through to deep midwicket

straight up, and Pandey snaps it up at extra cover (or maybe mid-off). Beautifully disguised wrong 'un against a batsman so dead set on getting his boundaries over the leg side. He doesn't get to the pitch, the ball shoots up off the top edge and the fielder is well in control of a swirler. Academic, really
flighted on off stump, pushed through to extra cover and calls, "two, two, two." Unless he wants to take on the fielder's arm, that's not on offer. Time out, by the way
nudged away behind square on the leg side for a single
another mistimed heave from Henriques. He's playing against the turn, and when he can't get to the pitch of it, the slog sweep will go off the outside edge
tossed up on middle, turned away rather smartly to deep midwicket
looped up outside off, drummed through the covers
that's the googly, and Karn being a leggie himself has picked it and powered it away to deep midwicket
fired into the blockhole, Karn digs it out to cover
goes on the bounce to long-on. That was how badly he had mistimed the slog. Length ball, there for the taking, but he can't make good enough contact
goes around to the left-hander, it's a short ball outside off, dabbed to deep third man
walks at the fast bowler, Umesh sneaks in a short ball, and the mistimed pull wanders away to long leg
shortish and outside off, slid off the open face to deep third man
good length ball on off stump, pushed to long-on

goes back to a good length ball, it's another slider, helps it off the inside edge to deep midwicket. Two is on, but Bipul is quite slow to turn. That could well cost him. But wait. it appears like the keeper's gloves have kissed the bails loose before he brings the ball over to knock on the stumps. It's terrribly close. The third umpire's looking at a lot of replays, but the ball was in his gloves when his webbing tips one of the bails over. And the big red letters tell him to go home
walks at him and tickles a flighted delivery off his pads to short fine leg

runs past a straight one! He was looking for extra cover having signalled his move way too early. Chawla drags his length back, refuses to give him the turn he wants and just smiles as Uthappa pulls off an easy stumping
this is short, but it turns too far from Henriques to connect properly with the cut. Bunts it to cover and has to settle for a single
looped up, drifts in on leg, Henriques has to be careful. Blocks it
gets down the track and works a flighted delivery wide of long-on
flighted on off stump, driven smartly to deep point
sneaks in the wrong 'un, and Vihari taps it back to the bowler. Very harmless indeed
fuller delivery on off stump, worked off the crease to deep midwicket. With the asking rate at 11, Hoggy's overs are phenomenally useful

huge appeal for stumping and Uthappa is absolutely delighted. Lots of air outside off and that's what makes Henriques go for an awful slog. He had dragged himself out of his crease while lunging forward, but by the time the keeper took the ball and pulled it over to the stumps, his back leg has been dragged back
flighted outside off, driven down the ground
he was setting up for a big, rasping square cut. But the ball bounces and turns way more than he expects and Vihari nearly gloves it onto his own stumps
looped up outside off, turned to long-on
good length ball on the stumps, kept out
ample turn off a shortish delivery outside off. Henriques looks for a whip through the leg side, but ends up with an inside edge through his legs. "Classy," says Danny Morisson
down the track to a good length ball and nudges it to long-on. Vihari wants a second run, but Henriques makes a loud and clear call of "no"
tossed up on leg stump, Vihari is duped into playing with the closed face and gets the leading edge to short third man
that's the googly on off stump, Henriques was opening his shoulders to lift it over extra cover. All he can do is skew it to long-on
length ball outside off, slapped away to the sweeper. Good work from Botha to keep it to a single
tries to slice the good length ball off the stumps square on the off side, only gets a bottom edge back to the bowler
tucked away towards square leg for a single
excellent work behind the stumps from Uthappa, standing up! It was dug in short and sliding miles down leg. He runs to his left and just about gets both hands to it
good length ball on off stump, kept out
back of a length and slower in pace, tucked away through square leg

is he gone? Yep, Morgan's walking off! It was slid well wide of him, and the ball kept low as well. Manages a cut towards point. Then the indecision hits. Morgan calls, and then worries about Gambhir at point. By that time Henriques has charged down. Then comes the fumble from the fielder and Morgan thinks he can make it, but Gambhir recovers quickly and gets the throw to the right end and Tendo breaks the stumps
seems to be the googly, slid  way down leg. Morgan works it to deep midwicket in search of a couple. Not there
stays back to a flatter trajectory and slaps the ball outside off to deep point
tossed up on middle, Henriques is forward to block into the covers. More spin for Chawla. Could do with a slip
good length ball, turned with the spin towards square leg
there's proper spin to his leggie. Drifts towards off, then turns to leg. The flight makes Morgan nervous as he plays a flick far too late for his own good
tossed up, doesn't spin outside off, Morgan waits and cuts to backward point
goes around the wicket to a flighted delivery outside off, defended and Uthappa screams, "Bowl like that"

more runs! That's the fifty, it's the short ball outside off, Henriques uses the depth of the crease and pulls to the midwicket boundary. Good, positive batting. And he might have hit the ball out of shape! The fourth umpire is out with a few replacements
"oh, come on," says the frustrated Uthappa as he watches a length ball muscled over long-on! Picks it up and launches it flat over the boundary
flighted on middle, Henriques chips it to wide long-on. Uthappa's gone up to the bowler to have a little word
mauled over square leg, miles over it in fact! That's how a long hop should he dealt with, steps down the track and simply heaves it away. Nothing pretty about the shot, but it hits the spot fine
shortish and outside off, slapped to deep point
flighted on middle, Morgan's solid against the finger spinner though. Drives to long-off and will have to handle Hoggy again, presumably
down the track to work a flighted ball to long-on
good length ball drifting onto the pads, as he bowls around the wicket, clipped behind square leg
fuller delivery on middle, pushed back at the bowler
flighted on middle and off, Morgan was reaching forward with his hands and the leading edge squirts to point
shortish and a shade outside off, punched to long-on. Bit of confusion between the two batsman before they finally decide on a single

huge shout as Hoggy traps Morgan in front of the stumps, but umpire Erasmus says it's too high. It's the googly again and the batsman's not picked it. Hurries into a flick to try and save himself. Lucky escape that

that would be embarrassing to both batsman and bowler! Dhawan was aiming to run down the track, so Hoggy dragged the googly down, as Dhawan was hoping. Nails a pull and then looks around to see Pandey at square leg with gobbling up the catch
lovely cut shot, nearly took it from the middle of off stump, but he finds point
good length ball on off stump, tapped through to deep midwicket
sneaks in the googly, Dhawan only reads it off the pitch and mistimes a flick. Inside edge wanders to short fine leg
gets some turn, but Henriques is able to work with it and flick to square leg
filghted on off stump, whipped to long-on
down the track, but he can't get to the pitch. Has to adjust his stroke, use soft hands and nudge towards mid-on
steps out, but can't pierce the cover field
slid into the pads, Dhawan was going for a flick, but the ball keeps a touch low. Slider that time beats the batsman
flighted into middle from around the stumps, blocked
goes back and clips a short delivery off his pads
good length ball on off stump, punched into the covers

straying on the pads and Dhawan has timed it stunningly well! So much that Russell on the boundary wasn't able to match up. And it looks bad! He's hurt his left shoulder and the physio's out straight away. The flick was travelling, quite a way away from the square leg fielder, Russell races across the outfield, dives, slaps the ball back but it still slithers away from him to the boundary. Meanwhile, he rolls over the boundary as well and lands awkwardly on his left shoulder, that's the problem. His own momentum works against him. He looked in a lot of discomfort, but he appears a lot better as he is walking off
back of a length on off stump, dabbed towards point
right up there on middle, Dhawan crunches it to cover
gets that seam going this time! Pitches on leg and jerks away past Dhawan's outside edge and through to the keeper. Stunning delivery again
they must have met in the nets tons of times over the summer, and this seems like cover drive practice. Floats up a fuller, wider delivery and it's thumped

thumped to cover point, good thing there was a man there. Henriques is looking good off the shortish length. Although ironically, he's playing them all off the front foot. Slow pitch, lads. Barely any bounce
144 kph, back of a length and outside off, defended
not quite the pitch to dig it in, only sits up around his stomach and Henriques pounds a pull well in front of square
shortish and outside off, Henriques meets it under his eyes
back of a length and outside off, slid off the open face to third man
that should perk up the Sunrisers fans. Caresses a good length ball through the gap in the covers and it just skims away

Ojha gone for a duck, the off stump goes for a toss. This was fuller and curls in from outside off, Ojha is crease-bound as he attempts a feeble drive. Too quick for him. He does not get hold of it and the off stump takes a beating
similar length and curves away outside off, ignored again
back of a length and moving away outside off, Ojha does not bother with it
Yadav drags this down leg, wide called
